name: rote
description: One rote skill that defers to `rote guidance` for adapters, plays, workspaces, registry, organizations, and browser automation.

interface.shortDescription: Day-to-day rote workflows with adapters, registry sharing, organization management, browser automation, and reusable results.
interface.longDescription: Invoked explicitly, when a Play step points at `rote guidance`, or when a `rote:` hook line routes the request. A `Play suggestion:` line does not activate rote. The single rote skill points the agent at `rote guidance root`, which routes through play search, adapters, workspaces, browser automation, registry sharing, and organization management.
